name: Lab Material
description: An AcousticMaterial from an absorption and a lab result, for the faces of the proxy in the room model: the flat stand-in for the detailed surface. Put it on the proxy only, never also on the detailed mesh, or the surface counts twice.

inputParameters.name: absorption
inputParameters.description: Optional. Absorption coefficients: 1 value for every band, or 7 values (125 Hz to 8 kHz). Used before 'material' when both are connected.

inputParameters.name: material
inputParameters.description: Optional. An AcousticMaterial to take the absorption from when 'absorption' is empty. 'absorption' wins when both are connected.

inputParameters.name: result
inputParameters.description: Optional. ScatteringResult object, from Scattering Lab: its scattering coefficients go on the material.

outputParameters.name: material
outputParameters.description: AcousticMaterial object, for the faces of the proxy.
